intro.text: A planetary system of seven planets, which its star chart names by number in the Eelakin fashion.

description.text: Its innermost planet, First of the Sun, has a large mainland and many islands where the Eelakin live. The Aviar birds are native to its Pantheon islands.
In the Physical Realm the system lies fairly close to Lumar, under a year's journey for starships slower than light.
